args.title: Product Recall FAQ
args.body:
## Product Recall FAQ

### What products are affected?

The recall applies to the specific stove model due to a potential defect. If you are unsure whether your stove is affected, please check the model number on the product label.

### What should I do if I own an affected stove?

If you own an affected stove, please stop using it immediately and contact our support team to arrange a replacement or refund.

### How can I check if my stove is affected?

You can check the model number on the product label and compare it with the list of affected models provided in this FAQ.

### What is the process for a replacement or refund?

If your stove is affected, you can contact our support team to arrange a replacement or refund. Please have your order number and model number ready when you contact us.

### Is there any additional information I should be aware of?

For any additional information, please contact our support team. We are here to assist you with any questions or concerns you may have regarding the recall.

- Address any operational challenges or concerns.

- Discuss any remaining issues and next steps.

### 5. At-Risk Accounts (20 min)
- Identify accounts with potential risks and propose mitigation strategies.
- Review action plans and timelines.

### 6. Open Discussion (10 min)
- Address any additional topics or concerns raised by the attendees.

### 7. Next Steps and Action Items (10 min)
- Summarize key decisions and assign action items.
- Set timelines for follow-up and progress tracking.
